_comment: Polygon outline of the wrist-mounted gripper as it appears in this rig's
IR streams -- the region ORB-SLAM3 must NOT extract features from.
Derived, not hand-drawn: anything rigidly attached to the camera stays
sharp in a long temporal average while world content blurs away as the
camera moves, so gradient magnitude of the temporal mean isolates it.
Fitted by voting that test across 12 independent samples (4 time slices
x 3 recordings), keeping pixels flagged in >=50% of them, then keeping
only blobs touching the bottom image edge (where the gripper enters
frame) and dilating 10px for finger open/close travel.
Measured extent was stable to +-0.1% of frame area across all three
recordings, with the top edge landing on row 371-372 every time.
Left/right polygons differ by roughly the stereo disparity, as expected.
Validated by eye on scan_0007, which was NOT used to fit it.
NOTE: describes the post-reassembly gripper (see commit a03a448).
scan_0001..scan_0005 predate this mounting and some have no gripper in
frame at all -- re-derive with scripts if the gripper is remounted.
